class.name: PCKExtractResult

method.name: is_ok
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if no error occurred, the same as [code]error == OK[/code]. Skipped, not editable files and dropped UIDs are not errors.

members.member: The UIDs ([code]uid://…[/code]) of extracted files that already belonged to other files. They were dropped: the [code].uid[/code] file was not written, or the UID was removed from the file. The editor assigns new UIDs on the next scan.
The first error that occurred, or [constant OK]. All errors are listed in [member errors].
One message per file that could not be read from the pack or written to the target folder.

Paths ([code]res://…[/code]) of files that were left out because they can't be edited as sources: resources converted on export (listed by their original path, for example [code]res://level.tscn[/code] for [code]res://level.tscn.remap[/code]), [code]res://project.binary[/code] and delta patches.
For each file that was written under a new name: its path in the pack ([code]res://…[/code]) as key, the written path as value. These files are also listed in [member written].

Paths ([code]res://…[/code]) of selected files that were not written: files that already exist (with [constant PCKPackageServer.EXTRACT_SKIP]), engine files below [code].godot/[/code], [code].import[/code] and [code].uid[/code] files without their source, removal entries, and [code].uid[/code] files whose UID was dropped.
The paths of the written files in the target folder, in pack order. Its size is the number of extracted files.
